failures.question: 每个月的订单量，以及相比上个月的变化量是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp)
),
monthly_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    order_count,
    order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_prev_month
  FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
  month,
  order_count,
  COALESCE(change_from_prev_month, 0) AS change_from_prev_month
FROM monthly_changes
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 24;

failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o1.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o1.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN o1.order_id END) AS orders_2018,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o1.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN o1.order_id END) AS orders_2017,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o1.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN o1.order_id END) - 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o1.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN o1.order_id END) AS growth
FROM 
    orders o1
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o1.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o1.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
    month
LIMIT 12;
